title: +EXPLORING CAREERS IN DATA SCIENCE
description: Explore the Data Science major and the interdisciplinary options within the major. Examine career goals and pathways to data science careers. Explore the concept of professional development. Expose students to data science applications in various fields and prepare them to be critical thinkers of future career paths.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: SCI 100*, 300*, CORE 100*, 300*, BA 100*, 300*, ENGR 110*, 110H*, 310*, LA 100*, 300*, ED 100*, 300* or minimum score of 1 in 'Baccalaureate Core Student'.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of D- is required in SCI 100, SCI 300, CORE 100, CORE 300, BA 100, BA 300, ENGR 110, ENGR 110H, ENGR 310, LA 100, LA 300, ED 100 and ED 300.
attribute_description: Core Education - Beyond OSU I, Career Preparation (CSC1)
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
